turns.user: Tin AI hôm nay có gì nổi bật?
turns.assistant_text:
Dưới đây là những tin tức nổi bật về AI hôm nay:

- **[Cuộc đua AI đang đặt bệnh nhân vào rủi ro](https://progressive.org/latest/the-ai-race-is-putting-patients-at-risk-adirim-20261110)** - Bài viết cảnh báo rằng AI có thể tạo ra các mối đe dọa mới trong y tế, từ việc hỗ trợ quyết định lâm sàng đến khả năng bị lạm dụng để tạo ra các tác nhân sinh học nguy hiểm. (Nguồn: progressive.org)

- **[AI đã vào phòng họp. Ai đang giám sát nó?](https://www.gsb.stanford.edu/insights/ai-has-entered-boardroom-whos-overseeing-it)** - Một khảo sát cho thấy 75% giám đốc sử dụng AI cho nghiên cứu và phân tích thị trường, nhưng nhiều công ty vẫn thiếu chiến lược giám sát AI. (Nguồn: gsb.stanford.edu)

- **[Chapman thúc đẩy nghiên cứu và đào tạo AI trong y tế](https://news.chapman.edu/2026/11/10/chapman-advances-healthcare-ai-research-and-training)** - Bài viết nói về sáng kiến Healthcare AI tại Chapman, nhằm giải quyết các thách thức trong y tế và phát triển các phương pháp học máy công bằng. (Nguồn: news.chapman.edu)

- **[Gilbert + Tobin tái định hình ngành luật với AI](https://openai.com/index/gilbert-tobin-sam-nickless)** - Bài viết khám phá cách mà AI có thể nâng cao chất lượng công việc trong ngành luật và khuyến khích việc sử dụng AI một cách có trách nhiệm. (Nguồn: openai.com)

- **[CoreWeave nhắm đến lợi nhuận vào năm 2028 khi nhu cầu AI vẫn mạnh](https://www.reuters.com/business/coreweave-beats-quarterly-revenue-estimates-ai-demand-defies-growing-doubts-2026-11-10)** - Bài viết đề cập đến sự tăng trưởng doanh thu của CoreWeave trong bối cảnh nhu cầu AI vẫn cao, mặc dù có những lo ngại về quy định. (Nguồn: reuters.com)

items.title: The AI Race is Putting Patients at Risk - Progressive.org
items.summary: Indeed, the most frightening risks involving AI are already moving from theory to capability. Frontier models let non-experts code new applications quickly, and soon it may be possible to use AI to create biological agents that can be weaponized. The White House’s own AI Action Plan warns that AI could create new pathways for bad actors to synthesize dangerous pathogens and calls for stronger screening and national security assessment of AI tools and systems. Anthropic has already said its [...] AI in health care offers many cases that regulatory frameworks should be addressing. A hospital can use AI for patient care and clinical decision support; an insurer for utilization management (e.g., automating care denials); a teenager for mental health advice; a public health department for outbreak detection; and a bad actor for infiltrating a hospital network. Different uses carry different risks and require separate risk-benefit analysis for determining regulatory guardrails. [...] Japan created an AI Strategy Headquarters headed by the prime minister and adopted a national AI basic plan. The United Kingdom and Australia are linking their AI safety institutes in order to better evaluate frontier AI model risks. These systems differ, but they have one thing in common - national AI governance.

items.title: AI Has Entered the Boardroom. Who’s Overseeing It? | Stanford Graduate School of Business
items.summary:
In the survey, 75% of directors said they used AI for research and market analysis, 55% for board prep and material summarization. Other common uses included strategic question generation and competitive benchmarking. Matthys says that board members would ideally like to use AI “to track and summarize board packages and more quickly understand year-to-year trends by using LLM tools rather than reading 80- to 100-page reports.” [...] The sooner the better, the researchers suggest. “Moving too slowly with AI governance means you may miss out on opportunities,” Saripalli says. “The board has fiduciary responsibility for anything that has impact at the product or service level.”

“The risk of not moving is as serious as the risk of AI systems running amok,” Matthys adds, noting how past technological shifts have left unprepared companies behind. “If you don’t keep up, there’s a risk that 20 years from now you won’t exist.” [...] ## In Brief

 A new survey finds that corporate boards are not keeping up with AI governance.
 Directors report that they are discussing and using AI, yet their boards lack a systematic approach to oversight.
 Companies that wait to define AI strategy and audit their AI use risk being left behind.

“We’re trying to change the wheels on the bus while driving it at 100 miles an hour downhill.”

items.title: Chapman Advances Healthcare AI Research and Training | Chapman Newsroom
items.summary:
Totonchy sees the skepticism around AI in higher education as an opportunity.  

“Generative AI quickly gained a negative reputation because it was seen as a tool for cheating,” she said. “That misses the point. These tools can work alongside humans, handling routine tasks so people can focus on analysis and decision-making. The sooner institutions move past resistance, the sooner AI can support that work.” 

STUDENTS PUT AI TO WORK [...] To address bias in clinical decision-making tools, Wang founded the Healthcare AI Initiative (HAI) at Chapman, bringing together researchers working on pressing healthcare challenges. HAI examines ethical questions surrounding AI, including data privacy, and develops equitable machine learning approaches.  

Wang also developed an AI elective within the School of Pharmacy, focused on practical applications for future clinicians. [...] “Every pharmacist has heard the rumors that AI will take pharmacists’ jobs,” Wang said. “But early exposure helps students. As future clinicians, they learn where the real focus should be in relation to AI. That’s something my students learn in this course.”  

Wang also works with students on research projects, extending that learning beyond the classroom. Two PharmD students, Elena Wu ’27 and Harvey Duong ’27, have collaborated with her on studies using AI to analyze large datasets.

items.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
items.summary:
The opportunity is bigger than doing the same work a little more quickly. Used well, AI can raise the quality and volume of what an organisation produces – and give people more time for the complex, strategic work where their expertise and judgement create the greatest value.

Find out more about Gilbert + Tobin’s work with OpenAI through the case studyhere.

## Keep reading

Image 2: Cooley customer story Option A art card

How Cooley is accelerating IPO work with ChatGPT Sep 17, 2026 [...] Governance should enable responsible use. Our message was simple: AI is not cheating. It is another tool people can use to apply their judgement. They still need to define the task, check the output and take responsibility for the final work.

## You’ve noticed that adoption is unusually high for your firm, with 87% active usage among enabled ChatGPT users, more than twice the rate Gilbert + Tobin typically sees for other tools. How did leadership shape that culture? [...] Gilbert + Tobin began by giving its people room to experiment with AI, then introduced ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Work and Codex to move from individual assistance to defined, multistep agentic workflows, with people responsible for review and approval.

We spoke with Sam Nickless, Partner and Chief Executive Officer at Gilbert + Tobin, about leading adoption from the front, where he’s seeing the value of AI, and his advice for other CEOs.

items.title: CoreWeave targets 2028 profitability as AI demand remains strong | Reuters
items.summary:
The ​steep selloff also triggered a broader crisis of confidence in the AI trade, a ⁠sentiment amplified by the Democrats' sweeping win in the US midterms that has fueled expectations of tighter ​regulation in the data-center build-out.

Earlier in the day, AI juggernaut Anthropic kicked off a roadshow for its share sale ​at a lower target valuation than earlier estimates.

- Bài viết cảnh báo rằng AI có thể tạo ra các mối đe dọa mới trong y tế, từ việc hỗ trợ quyết định lâm sàng đến khả năng bị lạm dụng để tạo ra các tác nhân sinh học nguy hiểm. - [progressive.org](https://progressive.org/latest/the-ai-race-is-putting-patients-at-risk-adirim-20261110)
